dashboard.label: Asset Health Correlation
dashboard.description: Correlate endpoint availability with other Splunk data sources

search.query: | inputlookup ping_monitor_settings_lookup | search _key="global" | head 1 | eval found="yes" | append [| makeresults | eval index="ping", sourcetype="ping_monitor", metrics_index="ping_metrics", found="no"] | head 1 | eval index=if(found=="yes", index, "ping") | eval sourcetype=if(found=="yes", sourcetype, "ping_monitor") | eval metrics_index=if(found=="yes", metrics_index, "ping_metrics") | fields index, sourcetype, metrics_index, found

index=$pm_index$ sourcetype=$pm_sourcetype$ record_type=summary | `ping_normalize` | stats latest(_time) as last_check, latest(hostname) as hostname, latest(packet_loss_pct) as packet_loss, latest(avg_latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms, latest(effective_state) as effective_state, latest(stale_after_seconds) as stale_after_seconds, latest(observation_status) as observation_status, latest(measurement_valid) as measurement_valid, latest(pings_successful) as pings_successful, latest(state_confidence) as state_confidence, latest(signal_quality) as signal_quality, latest(target_ip) as ip_address, latest(group) as group, latest(entitytype) as entitytype, latest(device) as device, latest(vendor) as vendor by endpoint_key | eval packet_loss_pct=packet_loss | `ping_enforce_observation_coherence` | eval latency=avg_latency_ms | `ping_apply_stale_state(last_check, stale_after_seconds)` | `ping_apply_health_label` | eval last_check_human = strftime(last_check, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval latency_display = if(latency > 0, round(latency, 2)." ms", "N/A") | table hostname, ip_address, health_status, observation_status, state_confidence, signal_quality, packet_loss, latency_display, group, entitytype, device, vendor, last_check_human | rename packet_loss as "Packet Loss %", latency_display as "Latency", last_check_human as "Last Check" | sort health_status, hostname

| mstats latest("ping.packet_loss_pct") as packet_loss_pct, latest("ping.state_code") as state_code, latest("ping.stale_after_seconds") as stale_after_seconds, latest("ping.avg_latency_ms") as avg_latency_ms, latest("ping.observation_code") as observation_code, latest("ping.measurement_valid") as measurement_valid, latest("ping.pings_successful") as pings_successful, latest("ping.observed_at_epoch") as observed_at_epoch WHERE index="$pm_metrics_index$" BY hostname, target_ip, group span=5m | stats latest(_time) as bucket_time, latest(observed_at_epoch) as observed_at_epoch, latest(packet_loss_pct) as packet_loss_pct, latest(avg_latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms, latest(state_code) as state_code, latest(stale_after_seconds) as stale_after_seconds, latest(observation_code) as observation_code, latest(measurement_valid) as measurement_valid, latest(pings_successful) as pings_successful, latest(group) as group by hostname, target_ip | `ping_metric_freshness(bucket_time, observed_at_epoch)` | `ping_apply_metric_state` | `ping_enforce_observation_coherence` | `ping_apply_stale_state(last_seen, stale_after_seconds)` | `ping_apply_health_label` | eval last_check_human = strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval latency_display = if(isnotnull(avg_latency_ms), round(avg_latency_ms, 2)." ms", "N/A") | eval packet_loss=packet_loss_pct | table hostname, target_ip, health_status, packet_loss, latency_display, group, last_check_human | rename target_ip as "IP Address", packet_loss as "Packet Loss %", latency_display as "Latency", last_check_human as "Last Check" | sort health_status, hostname

index=$pm_index$ sourcetype=$pm_sourcetype$ record_type=summary | `ping_normalize` | stats latest(_time) as last_check, latest(effective_state) as effective_state, latest(stale_after_seconds) as stale_after_seconds by endpoint_key | `ping_apply_stale_state(last_check, stale_after_seconds)` | `ping_apply_health_label` | stats count by health_status
index=$pm_index$ sourcetype=$pm_sourcetype$ record_type=summary | `ping_normalize` | `ping_apply_health_label` | timechart span=1h count by health_status

| mstats latest("ping.packet_loss_pct") as packet_loss_pct, latest("ping.state_code") as state_code, latest("ping.stale_after_seconds") as stale_after_seconds, latest("ping.observed_at_epoch") as observed_at_epoch WHERE index="$pm_metrics_index$" BY hostname span=5m | stats latest(_time) as bucket_time, latest(observed_at_epoch) as observed_at_epoch, latest(packet_loss_pct) as packet_loss_pct, latest(state_code) as state_code, latest(stale_after_seconds) as stale_after_seconds by hostname | `ping_metric_freshness(bucket_time, observed_at_epoch)` | `ping_apply_metric_state` | `ping_apply_stale_state(last_seen, stale_after_seconds)` | `ping_apply_health_label` | stats count by health_status

| mstats avg("ping.packet_loss_pct") as packet_loss, latest("ping.state_code") as state_code WHERE index="$pm_metrics_index$" BY hostname span=1h | eval packet_loss_pct=packet_loss | `ping_apply_metric_state` | `ping_apply_health_label` | timechart span=1h count by health_status

index=$pm_index$ sourcetype=$pm_sourcetype$ record_type=summary | `ping_normalize` | stats latest(_time) as last_check, latest(stale_after_seconds) as stale_after_seconds, latest(packet_loss_pct) as packet_loss, latest(hostname) as hostname, latest(avg_latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms, latest(effective_state) as effective_state, latest(observation_status) as observation_status, latest(measurement_valid) as measurement_valid, latest(pings_successful) as pings_successful, latest(target_ip) as ip, latest(group) as group, latest(entitytype) as entitytype by endpoint_key | eval packet_loss_pct=packet_loss | `ping_enforce_observation_coherence` | eval latency=avg_latency_ms | `ping_apply_stale_state(last_check, stale_after_seconds)` | where effective_state!="up" OR packet_loss>0 | `ping_apply_health_label` | eval latency = round(latency, 2) | table health_status, hostname, ip, packet_loss, latency, group, entitytype | rename health_status as "Status", packet_loss as "Loss %", latency as "Latency ms" | sort -packet_loss

| mstats latest("ping.packet_loss_pct") as packet_loss_pct, latest("ping.state_code") as state_code, latest("ping.stale_after_seconds") as stale_after_seconds, latest("ping.avg_latency_ms") as avg_latency_ms, latest("ping.observation_code") as observation_code, latest("ping.measurement_valid") as measurement_valid, latest("ping.pings_successful") as pings_successful, latest("ping.observed_at_epoch") as observed_at_epoch WHERE index="$pm_metrics_index$" BY hostname, target_ip, group span=5m | stats latest(_time) as bucket_time, latest(observed_at_epoch) as observed_at_epoch, latest(packet_loss_pct) as packet_loss_pct, latest(avg_latency_ms) as avg_latency_ms, latest(state_code) as state_code, latest(stale_after_seconds) as stale_after_seconds, latest(observation_code) as observation_code, latest(measurement_valid) as measurement_valid, latest(pings_successful) as pings_successful, latest(group) as group by hostname, target_ip | `ping_metric_freshness(bucket_time, observed_at_epoch)` | `ping_apply_metric_state` | `ping_enforce_observation_coherence` | `ping_apply_stale_state(last_seen, stale_after_seconds)` | where effective_state!="up" OR packet_loss_pct>0 | `ping_apply_health_label` | eval latency = if(isnull(avg_latency_ms),null(),round(avg_latency_ms, 2)), packet_loss=packet_loss_pct | table health_status, hostname, target_ip, packet_loss, latency, group | rename health_status as "Status", target_ip as "IP", packet_loss as "Loss %", latency as "Latency ms" | sort -packet_loss

index=$pm_index$ sourcetype=$pm_sourcetype$ record_type=summary | `ping_normalize` | stats latest(_time) as last_check, latest(effective_state) as effective_state, latest(stale_after_seconds) as stale_after_seconds by entitytype, endpoint_key | `ping_apply_stale_state(last_check, stale_after_seconds)` | stats count as assets, count(eval(effective_state="up")) as healthy_count by entitytype | eval health_pct = round((healthy_count / assets) * 100, 1) | eval status = case( health_pct >= 99, "Excellent", health_pct >= 90, "Good", health_pct >= 75, "Degraded", health_pct >= 50, "Impaired", true(), "Critical" ) | sort -health_pct | rename entitytype as "Entity Type", assets as "Assets", health_pct as "Health %", status as "Status"

index=$pm_index$ sourcetype=$pm_sourcetype$ record_type=summary | `ping_normalize` | stats latest(_time) as last_check, latest(effective_state) as effective_state, latest(stale_after_seconds) as stale_after_seconds by group, endpoint_key | `ping_apply_stale_state(last_check, stale_after_seconds)` | stats count as assets, count(eval(effective_state="up")) as healthy_count by group | eval health_pct = round((healthy_count / assets) * 100, 1) | eval status = case( health_pct >= 99, "Excellent", health_pct >= 90, "Good", health_pct >= 75, "Degraded", health_pct >= 50, "Impaired", true(), "Critical" ) | sort -health_pct | rename group as "Group", assets as "Assets", health_pct as "Health %", status as "Status"

| mstats latest("ping.state_code") as state_code, latest("ping.stale_after_seconds") as stale_after_seconds, latest("ping.observed_at_epoch") as observed_at_epoch WHERE index="$pm_metrics_index$" BY hostname, group span=5m | stats latest(_time) as bucket_time, latest(observed_at_epoch) as observed_at_epoch, latest(state_code) as state_code, latest(stale_after_seconds) as stale_after_seconds, latest(group) as group by hostname | `ping_metric_freshness(bucket_time, observed_at_epoch)` | `ping_apply_metric_state` | `ping_apply_stale_state(last_seen, stale_after_seconds)` | stats count as assets, count(eval(effective_state="up")) as healthy_count by group | eval health_pct = round((healthy_count / assets) * 100, 1) | eval status = case( health_pct >= 99, "Excellent", health_pct >= 90, "Good", health_pct >= 75, "Degraded", health_pct >= 50, "Impaired", true(), "Critical" ) | sort -health_pct | rename group as "Group", assets as "Assets", health_pct as "Health %", status as "Status"
